visualCharacteristics.layout: Grid of 1-3 equal teaser items; each: 16:9 image on top, optional bold title, short description and a small icon link (download icon for PDFs, chevron for pages); the whole item is a link. A single item fills its column (e.g. the 2/3 column beside the share price widget). Options: 'two-up' (max 2 per row), 'four-up' (4 per row from 900px), 'slider' (one horizontal scroll-snap row, 1/2/3/4 visible at <600/600/900/1200px, prev/next buttons, hidden when everything fits), 'tabbed' (adjacent tabbed instances in a section share one ARIA tab bar). Cards linking to video.continental.com get a play overlay and open the player iframe in a modal dialog

contentPattern: One row per teaser: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = optional h3 title, description paragraph(s), CTA link (e.g. "Find out more"). Optional first row holding only a heading = block heading (tab label for 'tabbed'); for 'tabbed' a heading directly before the block (last element of the preceding default content) is used when the block has no heading row. A CTA href of https://video.continental.com/?v={uuid} makes a video teaser. Shared helpers: /scripts/tab-group.js, /scripts/scroll-slider.js, /scripts/video-embed.js
